# Harold Llauca

## Hydrological Modeling, Forecasting & Water Resources

I build hydrological datasets, models, and operational forecasting systems that support flood and drought monitoring, climate services, and water resources decisions in Peru.

My work combines hydrological modeling, Earth observation, geomatics, and data science to transform hydroclimatic information into reproducible products and decision-support tools.

[View publications](publications.qmd){.btn .btn-primary}
[Read profile](about.qmd){.btn .btn-outline-primary}

## Featured Work

Selected projects and tools related to hydrological modeling, forecasting, climate services, and hydroinformatics.

:::::: grid
::: {.g-col-12 .project-card}
### SONICS

Operational hydrological monitoring and forecasting system for Peru, providing national-scale streamflow simulations, current hydrological conditions, and short-term forecasts.

[View platform](https://www.senamhi.gob.pe/sonics/){.project-link}
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .project-card}
### CAMELS-PE

A large-sample hydrological dataset for Peruvian catchments, designed to support hydrological modeling, regionalization, climate impact studies, and data-driven hydrology.

[View dataset](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.20058779){.project-link}
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .project-card}
### PISCO-ARNOVIC

National-scale hydrological dataset of daily streamflow simulations for Peru, developed using gridded hydroclimatic data and hydrological modeling.

[View dataset](https://www.hydroshare.org/resource/f723d6c762ca45b6936dd9489bc44842/){.project-link}
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .project-card}
### PISCO-GR2M

National-scale hydrological dataset of monthly streamflow simulations for Peru, developed using gridded hydroclimatic data and monthly hydrological modeling.

[View dataset](https://www.hydroshare.org/resource/f1b537f338f24533af5dab946b51d215/){.project-link}
:::
::::::
